title: onboard-specter-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Onboard Specter-13B v1.0 to the model registry and add automated changelog generation for model metadata and perf profiles. This PR adds the model manifest and metadata (model card, weights reference, tokenizer info), shipping performance profiles for common sequence lengths (16/128/512) and hardware targets (A10G, A100, T4). It also wires the registry's changelog automation so new model metadata changes populate release notes automatically. Includes small serving compatibility tests and an end-to-end perf validation harness invocation to capture baseline throughput/latency numbers. Motivation: Specter-13B is a candidate open model with good quality/cost tradeoff; adding onboard automation reduces manual steps and ensures consistent release notes for downstream consumers.
